sourceRefs.summary: Run-contract target that explains why this generated contract exists.
Runtime closeout recommends connecting the sampler to one live visual renderer, visual-frame adapters, representation transforms, generated imports, flashcards, and hardened ports.
Active KP frontier for dashboard-backed semantic animation system work.

allowedWork: Only work on the approved renderer-integration loop slices.
Start by proving one honest runtime-to-visual path before broader renderer work.
Keep AnimationAsset runtime frames, semantic refs, visual-frame adapters, dashboards, generated problems, flashcards, and deterministic ports typed and inspectable.
disallowedWork: Do not rewrite the full renderer or equation animation DOM pipeline in this loop.
Do not add GIF or video encoders in this loop.
Do not add live CAS, LSP, or network integrations; use deterministic fixtures.
Do not stage unrelated dirty worktree files.
goal: Connect the typed KpAnimationAsset runtime to real visual consumers, starting with KaTeX and dashboard sample cards, then visual-frame adapters, representation transforms, generated problems, flashcards, and deterministic ports.
stopConditions: Stop if a slice requires broad renderer replacement instead of an incremental runtime-to-visual adapter.
Stop if verification fails and the fix is not local to the active slice.
Stop if work requires GIF/video encoders, live CAS, live LSP, network access, or unrelated dashboard rewrites.
Stop when the approved slice list is exhausted.
